decisions.statement: A single candidate is answered without asking the disk.
The first candidate that is a directory is the answer.
A candidate that is a file rather than a directory is passed over.
A caller may hand in the test that says a candidate is present.
No candidate being present is refused with every candidate named.
Saved variables and addons sit beneath the live directory.

definition: the one live directory picked out of the candidates a workstation could have
